term: concrete external candidate distinct from all contingent concrete members
definition: OutsideContingentTotalityAt s w c holds when the rigid individual c differs from every actual individual x satisfying both concrete x and ContingentAt s.ontic w x. ExternalCandidateAt additionally asserts that c itself is concrete and exists at w. It does not independently assert c has causal powers, that a first contingent state can begin, or that any causal relation obtains. In classical quantified modal semantics, being a concrete external candidate is equivalent to being a concrete necessary individual at that standpoint; this is a consequence to verify, not an additional definition.
note: Scope audit for possible causal beginnings: distinguish a concrete bearer outside the totality from an abstract explanatory token or mere world-local relational role. The reader must not infer that an independent metaphysical argument has proved any such bearer exists.
